entities.summary: Jean Manuel Machi is a Venezuelan former professional baseball pitcher. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the San Francisco Giants, Boston Red Sox and Seattle Mariners. He was with the Giants for their 2012 World Series and 2014 World Series seasons.
